# streamline_memory (Resource)

Retains the legacy `streamline_memory` schema so existing state remains readable. The broker exposes remember/recall operations rather than CRUD for a memory-partition object, so Terraform cannot provision this model.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Legacy agent identifier.
- `tenant` (String) Legacy tenant namespace.

### Optional

- `decay_half_life_days` (Number) Legacy memory decay half-life.
- `decay_threshold` (Number) Legacy memory decay threshold.
- `encryption_enabled` (Boolean) Legacy encryption-at-rest setting.
- `episodic_retention_days` (Number) Legacy episodic retention setting.
- `procedural_retention_days` (Number) Legacy procedural retention setting.
- `semantic_retention_days` (Number) Legacy semantic retention setting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Legacy resource identifier (`{tenant}/{agent_id}`).
